asr.full_text: Ossetia City, Ukraine Polipeus PoliPoS PoliPoS Polipeus PoliPoS Ossetia City, Ukraine PoliPoS PoliPoS PoliPoS Please, answer me in more detail. On PoliPoS we all everyone watches and understands how ICO is doing. Everyone knows that now the investments can be made from 25%... Absolutely correct, yes. The ICO has been extended for another 24 hours. Till tomorrow, or till 3 o'clock. 25% bonus. I was so lucky to show you at the conference right here. I'm sure everything went well. Please, why did you choose such method to collect revenue? What are the advantages of this method to crowdfunding or venture capital? There are several reasons. for example, crowdfunding, services will be useful for them Secondly, we wanted to get rid of myriadic rights At this moment there is the Dividendy token and it provides some dividends After the token begins to provide the myriadic rights it restricts the number of participants which can participate in the funding For crowdfunding it is very important to give as many people as possible. So, if you want to get an additional amount to the people who are not available. I understand correctly that you wanted your investors to be the first people who would like the service? Yes, it is exactly the same. We do the service for crypto-lovers in particular and therefore serve as the service for them, for those who invest Ok. That's a great idea Can you share with me? I know you have very many global plans in the blockchain world What other fields, besides banking, are you planning to work on in this field? And for what purpose we are able to use blockchain in our everyday lives? Well, of course. The key technology that Polybius is developing except for the banking itself is, of course, Digital Path It's a digital personality infrastructure This is infrastructure, digital individuals, which allows you to verify and authorize other services. It is based on euro-based electronic ID. In Estonia we can vote on some bank transactions with help of electronic ID. However, we consider it is should refer to all services which are only possible So a decision which can help to remove this bureaucratic part As well as paper filth Yes, so all your information is in one place Instead to put thousands of accounts in each service You always have an opportunity through a unified aggregator In the form of us, or a digital pass to be authorized in any service. Super! Sounds really good! In the world of crypt$economy, the ideas of anonymity that people can use, are a lot spread now. You work in the opposite direction of unification, enhancing the comfort of services. But how do you plan to work with these people who, in principle, they use blockchain and crypto currencies with an anonymous perspective and hiding some of the information to their minds. Yes, of course. Firstly, I say that as a community, my work is communication with general. I listen to people's comments on internet that you make. And I should note that many communities are polarized right now. Half of them believes that they can exist only by anonymity and the other half think that the technologies should come from the shadows of certain conditions and goes into the mainstream where it should to out of shadow, enter mainstream. For this, some European regulations are required, we think that services that we provide even for organizations out of traditional financial system that work with cryptos, blockchain technologies can be of better use to bank services. Many say, my wallet is also my bank. I can go in, make a transaction, transfer money. There is no doubt about it. However, in addition to saving money, the banking services such as credit, leasing and insurance are needed. There are good knowledge banks that people can try to use? Sure thing, truly. everything you may want every single company needs to know this and get a lot people to use it sure we don't think that this little centralization is going to affect the initial idea of technology I see. It's very interesting Tell please the world do you see the world for example in a year? When your ICO and plans will be completed. How will the world be changed? We imagine in this way you work on local blockchain, as you know bitcoin will be something else. I think what we see now is the introduction ofation of both crypto and fintech, as well as blockchain. The last 7-8 years, we observed that institutions, including banks are related to financial crisis since 2008. Since that, innovations are not our primary priority, but in our world now, everything that relates to our everyday life, innovations are the one the most important element. If we just look at uber, airbnb, netflix, and all other, all services that we use lately are are based on new and technical innovations. That's why we and many fintech-players will start to take part in banking as well. So it will happen soon. And we will set a new task in 2018. Because in 2018 we will use European Directive is launched this year which completely changes European banks so the data might change starting at the end of this year All banks that exist in Europe now need to open their APIs that is, create their bases and integrate them into fintech That means fintech players have to be able to mention the integration with fintech, so fintech players can use their own game software without any bank permission, and licensed accounts by Europe's governments The same applies to accounts on banks, these will also be easy source open open for licensed players as well. For instance, the digital pass provider. For each European bank using the system. This is a perfect product which everyone can use. This is our implementation time, we chose it to be used. Great, I want to add several words. I know your decisions are oriented kind of medical institutes. How will it work? Can you give us an overview? Not only the medical, not all, healthcare, education, shopping – so the same. There are a few startups in Estonia that make these registered medical records. Well, so you don't have to hide medical records any other way. Yes, you can use medical record or any other health records to make sure that that information will be available to any European country. It's connected to your identity. Digestive, and it's accessible in each European country. So if you left your country in another European one and accidentally do something wrong, using you ID and your ID doctors will also know your medical studies. I think it's already good for our kids. I hope it will be followed in the next future and the last question how do you like today's show and exhibition? have you performed at such events before? and how do you evaluate today's events? of course the conference in Berlin is always very interesting and very good today a lot of video on the topic of The IT AI conference besides, there was a the interesting gathering of smart cities to see what the future city will look like. There's an interesting part of this event that was taking the perspective of Internet of Things, but I think later everything would be possible to combine. Yes absolutely, that's once again the same old EU regulations so much more collaboration possibilities are happening now. So you don't understand who is your actual competitor because they have access to your data, but at the same time, they are a potential collaborator, or a potential partner, or a potential client ... Converter approach comes from other perspective. Yeah, yeah, the concept and here the light is lost Thank you very much, this was an interesting interview I hope you'll like it Thank you for your time If possible also visit Polybius.io our landing is for ICO visit, take a look To read detailed information on Polybius follow the ICO and investment process it is possible to visit the Polybius, follow the ICO flow and invest, you can on the PolybiusIO site Thank you for watching this video and for being interested in blockchain and cryptocurrencies Do not forget to subscribe to channel and watch other videos See you in the video and Telegram chat TerpanDigest, the link to it is expected you in the description
